description.value: Awesome Bagel & More is a downtown Vancouver café located steps from Canada Place, serving handcrafted bagels baked fresh daily, gourmet sandwiches, artisan pastries, Italian-style gelato, and espresso drinks. It positions itself as a gathering spot for locals, tourists, and professionals and operates with indoor seating only. The online menu spans over 57 items across categories including breakfast bagels, paninis, soups, and a full espresso bar.
